ns2:course.label: Grievance Representation
ns2:course.description: Examines how a union steward represents workers on the job, including how to investigate, write and negotiate grievances, and how to utilize the law to defend workers' right on the job. Students will work collectively on case studies to determine how a steward would respond to grievances on issues such as insubordination, absenteeism, vacation, overtime, safety, and racial and sexual harassment.
